bio: Charles Graham Halpine (1829–1868), born at Oldcastle, County Meath, was a journalist and poet who wrote anti-secession verse as "Miles O'Reilly" and rose to brigadier-general in the American Civil War. He died in New York.
The poems here are taken from H. Halliday Sparling's anthology Irish Minstrelsy (London: Walter Scott, 1888).
